assertions.subject: Cardiomyopathies
assertions.quote: Cardiomyopathies are a heterogenic group of diseases of the myocardium

assertions.subject: Primary cardiomyopathies
assertions.quote: genetic “including hypertrophic, arrhythmogenic right ventricular, left ventricular noncompaction, Danon glycogen storage disease and others”

assertions.subject: Secondary cardiomyopathies
assertions.quote: The secondary cardiomyopathies occur due to systemic diseases

assertions.subject: Cardiomyopathy
assertions.quote: Diagnosis of the etiology of cardiomyopathy starts with a thorough history and physical exam

assertions.subject: Dilated cardiomyopathy
assertions.predicate: increased left and right ventricular size
assertions.quote: In dilated cardiomyopathy, the chest radiograph will show increased left and right ventricular size

assertions.subject: Cardiomyopathy
assertions.quote: Cardiomegaly on chest radiograph usually reflects the decreased ejection fraction

assertions.subject: Acute congestive heart failure
assertions.quote: The chest radiograph can show evidence of cardiomegaly and increased cephalization, pleural effusion, and Kerley B-lines in the setting of acute congestive heart failure
